thread:
maria-support: Escalation from concierge: customer reports their 14-day trial credits dropped to zero overnight. They say they only ran interactive queries, no bulk jobs.

ana-cs: Got their note. Customer included a short trace and a console screenshot showing a bunch of rerank attempts.

maria-support: Do we have any job ids? key suffix? promo id?

ana-cs: They attached this snippet: 
```json
{\"job_id\":\"rq_e3b1c4\",\"user_id\":\"concierge-77\",\"endpoint\":\"/v1/rerank\",\"attempts\":24,\"last_status\":502}
```

devin-eng: header they sent shows X-Request-ID=req-7c1d2aa and api key suffix `trial-77`. Promo_code empty.

ops-bot: scheduler-service: run job schedule/concierge-migrate at 2026-03-11T01:58:12Z for tenant concierge-77

infra-oncall: Hypothesis: on our side a scheduled worker retried the rerank with tiny backoff so attempts piled up and each attempt was billed. Also rate-limiter cache TTL might be mis-set so rapid retries bypassed throttling.

devin-eng: I pulled runtime logs. Worker used BACKOFF_MULTIPLIER=0.05 due to a bad default in the onboarding image. Here are snippets: 
``n[01:58:12Z] rq_e3b1c4 attempt=1 -> upstream 502
[01:58:12Z] rq_e3b1c4 attempt=2 -> upstream 502
... repeated every 80ms ...
[02:42:11Z] rq_e3b1c4 attempt=24 -> gave up
```

maria-support: Customer insists they didn't schedule anything. Could a managed connector they use have kicked this off? ana-cs any onboarding tasks that run background reranks?

ana-cs: We run a one-time ownership migration for new concierge installs, but it uses a different service key and runs at noon PST. This looks like a separate retry storm. I'll check onboarding logs and linking to tenant id.

devin-eng: Also found two sibling job ids within the same hour with same failure signature from that tenant. Aggregated attempts ~68. Token estimate: average rerank payload ~60 tokens per request -> ~4k tokens across retries. But billing rounding + multiple workers could make it look larger.

billing-team: Can you send the exact job ids and request ids? We'll map to billing events and identify whether trial grant was attached to those request records or a different billing_key.

maria-support: Sent: rq_e3b1c4, rq_f2a9b1, rq_b7d9e0 and request ids req-7c1d2aa, req-7c1d2ab. Customer key suffix trial-77.

infra-oncall: Repro steps to validate quickly: 1) enqueue rerank job that always returns 502 2) set BACKOFF_MULTIPLIER=0.05 3) run worker -> should see ~20-80 rapid retries and each attempt counts towards billing.

devin-eng: Found a related bug: rate-limiter caches key->quota mapping for 30s but the cache was evicted early in some worker images, causing a window where the quota lookup fell back to permissive path. Combined with tiny backoff, quotas weren't enforced. Patch posted in hotfix branch.

ops-bot: ticket created INC-6524 assigned to devin-eng and infra-oncall

maria-support: Action items:
- devin-eng: compile full list of job ids + token estimate + raw request ids and send to billing for credit reversal
- infra-oncall: patch default BACKOFF_MULTIPLIER in onboarding image and fix rate-limiter cache TTL regression
- ana-cs: confirm whether any managed onboarding tasks used the `trial-77` key and notify customer of provisional credit

ana-cs: I'll apply a provisional credit for the trial equal to the estimated burn and keep customer updated.

billing-team: Received the events. We'll audit charges; if matches retries we'll refund and attribute to platform-side retry storm. ETA for customer note: 24h after full audit.

maria-support: Drafting the customer update: "Provisional credit applied. Root cause appears to be a platform retry/backoff + rate-limit cache issue; final credit will be confirmed after billing audit." Anyone object?

devin-eng: No objections. Leaving notes in the PR with logs and repro.

infra-oncall: Hotfix PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1428. Will roll out patch to onboarding images and schedulers in next deploy window.

ana-cs: Thanks everyone. I'll close the loop with concierge and include the ticket link INC-6524 and PR link.
